+@dataclass
+class FableReliabilityProfile:
+    """Rolling window statistics for one model: success rate, cost variance."""
+    model: str
+    window_size: int = 100
+    successes: int = 0
+    failures: int = 0
+    total_calls: int = 0
+    mean_cost_usd: float = 0.0
+    cost_variance: float = 0.0
+
+    def success_rate(self) -> float:
+        return self.successes / self.total_calls if self.total_calls > 0 else 0.0
+
+    def update(self, success: bool, cost_usd: float) -> None:
+        self.total_calls += 1
+        if success:
+            self.successes += 1
+        else:
+            self.failures += 1
+        # Simple running mean/variance (Welford's would be better for prod)
+        delta = cost_usd - self.mean_cost_usd
+        self.mean_cost_usd += delta / self.total_calls
+        delta2 = cost_usd - self.mean_cost_usd
+        self.cost_variance += delta * delta2
+        # Window enforcement: reset if beyond limit
+        if self.total_calls > self.window_size:
+            self.successes = int(self.successes * 0.9)
+            self.failures = int(self.failures * 0.9)
+            self.total_calls = int(self.total_calls * 0.9)

+class FableBudgetForecaster:
+    """Worst-case cost estimation for token budgets with cache effects."""
+
+    # Pricing per 1M tokens (example rates, adjust to actual Anthropic pricing)
+    OPUS_INPUT_PER_M = 15.0
+    OPUS_OUTPUT_PER_M = 75.0
+    OPUS_CACHE_WRITE_PER_M = 18.75
+    OPUS_CACHE_READ_PER_M = 1.50
+    SONNET_INPUT_PER_M = 3.0
+    SONNET_OUTPUT_PER_M = 15.0
+    SONNET_CACHE_WRITE_PER_M = 3.75
+    SONNET_CACHE_READ_PER_M = 0.30
+
+    @classmethod
+    def worst_case(cls, model: FableModel, input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int,
+                   cache_eligible: bool = False) -> float:
+        """Conservative estimate: assume cache miss, full write cost."""
+        if model == FableModel.OPUS:
+            inp = cls.OPUS_CACHE_WRITE_PER_M if cache_eligible else cls.OPUS_INPUT_PER_M
+            out = cls.OPUS_OUTPUT_PER_M
+        elif model == FableModel.SONNET:
+            inp = cls.SONNET_CACHE_WRITE_PER_M if cache_eligible else cls.SONNET_INPUT_PER_M
+            out = cls.SONNET_OUTPUT_PER_M
+        else:
+            return 0.0
+        return round((input_tokens * inp + output_tokens * out) / 1_000_000, 6)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def expected_case(cls, model: FableModel, input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int,
+                      cache_hit_prob: float = 0.0) -> float:
+        """Expected cost with partial cache hit probability."""
+        if model == FableModel.OPUS:
+            inp_miss = cls.OPUS_INPUT_PER_M
+            inp_hit = cls.OPUS_CACHE_READ_PER_M
+            out = cls.OPUS_OUTPUT_PER_M
+        elif model == FableModel.SONNET:
+            inp_miss = cls.SONNET_INPUT_PER_M
+            inp_hit = cls.SONNET_CACHE_READ_PER_M
+            out = cls.SONNET_OUTPUT_PER_M
+        else:
+            return 0.0
+        inp_cost = (inp_miss * (1 - cache_hit_prob) + inp_hit * cache_hit_prob) * input_tokens
+        return round((inp_cost + output_tokens * out) / 1_000_000, 6)
+
